verdict.rationale: Tracking US equity compliance is a fair question for a cap table and equity management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only UK filings (Companies House automation, EMI/CSOP schemes, SEIS/EIS) and a paid 409A valuation service for US taxpayers. A 409A valuation is an adjacent service, not automated tracking or generation of Rule 701 thresholds, Form 3921 filings or 83(b) elections, and nothing in the pack documents those.
